meta.title: RepoChan — Hand Your Repo to Repo-chan · Frutiger Aero
meta.description: One command turns a git repository into a full brand kit: a mascot persona, foundation sheets, stickers, patterns, posters, and a website that breathes. analysis → interview → persona → art-director → painter → assembly.

hero.lead: One command turns a git repository into a full brand kit — a mascot persona, foundation sheets, stickers, patterns, posters, and a website that breathes. As easy as bubbles rising to the surface.
hero.dogfood: Every visual on this page is a real product of this very pipeline

pipeline.kicker: PIPELINE · SIX STEPS TO THE SURFACE
pipeline.headingPost: to a whole ocean of brand
pipeline.lead: A deterministic CLI handles scanning and protocol; agents handle creative judgment. Every step is an atomic repochan subcommand — like strings of bubbles, rising one after another.

steps.title: Read the repo
steps.desc: A deterministic scan of the stack, structure, and commit temperament, then an LLM abstracts the dimensions — a self-portrait of your repository.

steps.title: Talk about feelings
steps.desc: The Interviewer asks 7–14 questions about tone, audience, and worldview — you say out loud what kind of soul you want.

steps.title: Repo-chan is born
steps.desc: World Architect, Character Designer, and Consistency Keeper work together, growing a living mascot persona out of the analysis report.

steps.title: The director commissions
steps.desc: The foundation sheet and every downstream Asset Order are created in one pass, keeping the character consistent across all assets.

steps.title: The painter paints
steps.desc: Resolve visual references, prepare briefs, pick the best generation path. Foundation-first — every piece can be reviewed and revised.

steps.title: Page assembly
steps.desc: The designer assembles assets into a complete website: art direction, visual masters, responsive implementation — like the page you're scrolling right now.

assets.heading: Assets grown out of a repo
assets.lead: Foundation sheets, stickers, posters, patterns, icons, web-state tiles — every bubble holds the product of a real order, not a placeholder.
